text: Two features with similar names, and genuinely different jobs. Let's tell them apart.
Drill mode stays inside one visual — up a level, down a level, or expand everything at once, the same four icons from Chapter 7's third lesson.

Drillthrough is bigger: it takes you to an entirely separate report page. Add a page, drag a field into the Drillthrough filters well, and Power BI adds a Back button automatically. Build visuals around that one filtered item — a card, a table, a trend line.

Right-click any data point that shares the drillthrough field, hover Drillthrough, pick the page — Power BI navigates there, already filtered to what you clicked. A button with its action set to Drillthrough works the same way, just more visible than a right-click.
Next: buttons, bookmarks, and navigation — building a guided experience instead of a static page.
